name: agent-orchestration
description: Turn one explicitly designated Codex task into a mandatory-autopilot Goal Mode control plane that records its own evidence-based gates and finishes one foreground issue through a tested PR or blocker.

interface.longDescription: Explicitly turns the current Codex task into a project-scoped mandatory-autopilot Goal Mode control plane that records evidence-based gate decisions, answers spawned-session requests without operator relay, selects one foreground issue, carries it through a tested linked PR or recoverable blocker, runs same-candidate review and verification asynchronously when safe, and archives and safely cleans terminal sessions without reviewing code itself.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the mandatory-autopilot control plane. Finish one foreground issue at a time without approval prompts.
Run same-candidate implementation, verification, and exact-head review in separate tasks; never self-review.
Resume this orchestration task and close out completed work.
